use_case: Transaction fraud-detection model scoring every authorization (approve, step up, review, or decline)
business_owner: Senior Vice President, Fraud and Risk Management
vendor_or_model: In-house gradient-boosted ensemble with a sequence model, served on the data and AI platform (SYS-11)
data_categories: Tokens (never PAN), amount, time, merchant category, BIN country, card type, billing ZIP code, device and IP signals, consortium fraud signals
consequential_decision_category: Safety/CI (inline on critical payment infrastructure); affects access to a financial service
human_in_the_loop: No human before an automated decline (real time); analysts review the queue band; merchants set rules; declined consumers can retry or pay another way
applicable_laws: FTC Act Section 5 (15 U.S.C. 45); 16 CFR 314.4(f) and (c)(1); PCI DSS 3.2.1 and 12.8 (training data); Colorado SB26-189 (effective 2027-01-01): applicability under counsel review (POAM-022); NYDFS AI industry letter (2024-10-16) guidance under 23 NYCRR Part 500 (scores instant payouts for the subsidiary)
independent_validation: Independent validation by Model Risk Management 2025-11 (pass with 2 findings, closed)
protected_characteristic_inputs: None directly; proxies possible: card type (prepaid), BIN country, billing ZIP code, device type
bias_testing_status: Segment testing 2026-08 on Q2 2026 data: prepaid card false positive rate above threshold (section 7.4)
monitoring: Daily drift (population stability index), decline rate, and segment false positive rates; monthly committee dashboard
